tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: Ivory (light), deep plum night (dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tab bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Champagne: warm panels, grouped lists, empty states.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Plum Ink: all body and heading text (13.7:1 on surface, 9.9:1 on blush, 11.8:1 on champagne).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: seller place, timestamps, captions (6:1 on surface, 5.2:1 on champagne).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders; never text.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Soft Taupe: disabled states, quiet chips, illustration neutrals; never text on light.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep rose for brand text and icons: links, active tab, small brand accents (5.5:1 on surface). Never on blush; use ink there.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Dusty Rose, the primary brand colour: large fills, avatar rings, cover blocks. Text on it is always ink (5.2:1), never ivory.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-fill.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft backgrounds: selected chip, product tag pill, highlight rows. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Dark surfaces: welcome hero, pickup-code card, Captured badge.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text on plum (13.7:1 light, 11.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The one action colour: Buy now, Post, primary buttons. Max one marigold button per screen.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text on marigold, always plum, never white (6.7:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Sage Green, trust only: verified badge, Protected Pay, delivered (5.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Background for trust badges and the Protected Pay banner (sage on it 4.8:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Antique Gold: handmade label fills, maker highlights, illustration; text on it is ink (5.6:1).

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Antique gold as text: 'Handmade' label, maker awards (6.1:1 on surface, 5.3:1 on champagne).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors, cancelled orders, report actions.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px surface gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tags; between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps; grid gutter on the profile grid is 2px, not this.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of sheets, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small chips, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, product cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, post media corners, large cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, the trust badge, the product tag on a post.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the floating Buy bar; dark theme relies on surface-raised instead.
